item.title: House Democrat Reports FBI Interception of His Calls
item.description: Rep. Suhas Subramanyam, D-Va., stated on Thursday that his phone conversations with the Virginia Senate's top Democrat were intercepted as part of a federal investigation.

item.title: Trump Administration Proposes Tax-Exempt Status Removal for Schools with Race-Based Programs
item.description: The Trump administration has proposed new regulations that would remove the tax-exempt status of private schools that offer targeted programs supporting specific racial groups.

item.title: Musk Super PAC Invests $800,000 in 15 Midterm Races
item.description: Elon Musk's super PAC has allocated $800,000 to 15 House and Senate races as Republicans aim to retain control of both chambers.
